message:
Yen receipts now show correctly: `Paid ¥500 by card` instead of `Paid ¥5.00 by card`. All 18 tests pass.

The real bug is in the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100, which is wrong for yen because yen has no minor unit. That file belongs to other teams, so I left it alone. I fixed it in `src/payments/receipt.js` instead. The receipt now prints JPY amounts as whole units and passes other currencies to `formatMoney` as before.

Invoices, cart and admin probably show yen wrong in the same way. The proper fix is in `formatMoney`, so you may want to tell the team that owns it.
